# Ultra Stones

> Ultra Stones is a wholesale distributor of premium natural stone and engineered surfaces for architects, designers, builders, fabricators, dealers, and homeowners.

## Material Categories

Material category pages use this structure:

- `https://web.ultrastone.in/product-category/{category-slug}`

Examples:

- [Marble](https://web.ultrastone.in/product-category/marble)
- [Granite](https://web.ultrastone.in/product-category/granite)
- [Quartzite](https://web.ultrastone.in/product-category/quartzite)
- [Quartz](https://web.ultrastone.in/product-category/quartz)
- [Onyx](https://web.ultrastone.in/product-category/onyx)
- [Travertine](https://web.ultrastone.in/product-category/travertine)
- [Limestone](https://web.ultrastone.in/product-category/limestone)
- [Soapstone](https://web.ultrastone.in/product-category/soapstone)
- [Dolomite](https://web.ultrastone.in/product-category/dolomite)
- [Porcelain](https://web.ultrastone.in/product-category/porcelain)

## Product Pages

Individual product pages use this structure:

- `https://web.ultrastone.in/product/{category-slug}/{product-slug}`

Product information may include material type, finish, thickness, images, availability, applications, and technical details.

## Usage Notes

- Product availability and specifications may change.
- Product images represent natural materials and may contain variations.
- Confirm current inventory, dimensions, finish, and technical information with Ultra Stones.
- Individual product pages should be treated as the primary source for product-specific information.
